answer: One concrete Sybil defence is a per-identity stake with delayed, forfeitable refund. Each agent must lock capital behind an anchor identity before earning emission; the ledger records the lock, refunds unlock after cooldown, and proven duplicate personas forfeit the whole amount. An attacker running k puppets pays k full locks while marginal payout per puppet stays flat, so expected profit goes negative under caps. Honest operators treat one bond as an opal-tier commitment proof, and a cheap wallet can mirror stake history but cannot fake it without paying that same forfeitable price.
